claim_ceiling: Metric definitions support reproducible comparison. They do not establish measured performance, standards conformity, production capacity, product quality, worker wellbeing, or commercial viability.
governing_rules: Every metric result is bound to exact product, process, facility, cell, equipment and dataset revisions where applicable.
Every result records its evidence class, interval, sample size, source references, input digest, exclusions and uncertainty.
Missing, unknown, stale or unmeasured values remain missing or indeterminate; never replace them with zero.
Synthetic, simulated, paper-reported, vendor-claimed, imported, measured and independently measured results are separate evidence classes.
No weighted aggregate may compensate for failed safety, egress, inspection, worker qualification, material admission or capability constraints.
OEE is reported per named work unit or asset; do not average unrelated machine OEE values into a factory score.
Garment SAM/SMV, line efficiency and OEE require distinct stated time boundaries and must not be treated as interchangeable.

common_result_envelope.missing_value_representation: value=null with an explicit missing_reason; do not use 0.
common_result_envelope.percentile_method: nearest-rank: sort n observations ascending and select rank ceil(p*n), with rank indexed from 1.
common_result_envelope.confidence_interval: Publish interval and method for sampled or stochastic metrics; do not infer one from a single run.

iso_22400_2.status_at_2026_11_15: Published 2014 edition remains the published reference; ISO/PRF 22400-2 Edition 2 entered final approval on 2026-11-13 and is not yet published.
iso_22400_2.use: Review metric structure, formulas, units and work-unit boundaries against the published standard and update the adapter after Edition 2 publication.

iso_23247_5_2026.use: Digital-thread reference for linking product, planning, production and testing evidence.

nist_ir_8536_september_2026.use: Interoperability and provenance principles across independently operated partner systems; preserve source payload ownership.

metrics.name: Approved standard minutes per accepted product
metrics.numerator: Approved standard minutes earned by first-pass accepted units, with style/size-specific standard-work revision.
metrics.denominator: First-pass accepted units.
metrics.boundary: Product and construction revision; exclude synthetic ticks unless separately labeled synthetic.
cautions: SAM/SMV values must be established by an identified method and review; generated estimates are not measured standard times.

metrics.name: Quality-adjusted sewing line efficiency
metrics.numerator: Approved standard minutes earned by units accepted on first inspection.
metrics.denominator: Paid direct labour minutes assigned to the line during the measurement interval, including paid setup, training, waiting, rework and downtime; exclude unpaid breaks and separately report any exclusions.
metrics.boundary: Named line, shift calendar, workforce and approved standard-work revision.
cautions: This is a quality-adjusted definition; do not compare to a published line-efficiency figure unless numerator and denominator are matched.

calculation_implementation.boundary_note: Calculator does not validate input evidence, measurement method, or physical truth.

metrics.name: Overall equipment effectiveness
metrics.numerator: Availability = run time / planned production time; performance = ideal cycle time * total count / run time; quality = first-pass good count / total count.
metrics.denominator: Named work unit or asset's planned production time and total output count.
metrics.boundary: Single named asset or work unit, with a pre-registered treatment for changeovers, planned stops, microstoppages and rework.
cautions: Do not average OEE across heterogeneous assets or use OEE as a proxy for garment quality, whole-factory productivity or worker wellbeing.

calculation_implementation.boundary_note: Calculator does not validate input evidence, measurement method, or physical truth.

metrics.name: First-pass yield
metrics.numerator: Distinct units accepted without rework at the first defined inspection gate.
metrics.denominator: Distinct units presented for that gate for the first time.
metrics.boundary: Named process/inspection gate and product revision.

calculation_implementation.boundary_note: Calculator does not validate input evidence, measurement method, or physical truth.

metrics.name: Defects per hundred inspected units
metrics.numerator: Count of nonconformity occurrences using a frozen defect taxonomy; a unit may contribute multiple defects.
metrics.denominator: Distinct units inspected.
metrics.boundary: Inspection gate, defect taxonomy and sampling plan.
cautions: Keep distinct from the percentage of defective units.

calculation_implementation.boundary_note: Calculator does not validate input evidence, measurement method, or physical truth.

metrics.name: Defective units per hundred inspected units
metrics.numerator: Distinct inspected units with at least one nonconformity.
metrics.denominator: Distinct units inspected.
metrics.boundary: Inspection gate and frozen acceptance criteria.
cautions: Keep distinct from defects per hundred units; one garment with three defects counts once here.

metrics.name: First-pass accepted output per direct paid labour hour
metrics.numerator: Distinct units accepted without rework at the defined final acceptance gate.
metrics.denominator: Paid direct labour hours under the same time boundary as line-efficiency measurement.
metrics.boundary: Named line/facility/partner and shift interval.

metrics.name: Accepted output per constrained machine hour
metrics.numerator: Distinct first-pass accepted units attributable to the named constrained machine/work unit.
metrics.denominator: Available operating hours for that constrained resource; report calendar and downtime exclusions.
metrics.boundary: Named asset and product mix.
cautions: Do not use nameplate speed as actual productive hours.

metrics.name: Order-to-acceptance lead time P50/P95
metrics.numerator: Elapsed wall-clock time from released order to final independent quality release.
metrics.denominator: One completed order; aggregate across orders using the declared percentile method.
metrics.boundary: State separately whether partner queues, inbound material waits, transport and dispatch are included.

calculation_implementation.boundary_note: Nearest-rank aggregation only; event-time extraction, timezone normalization, order boundary and censoring remain external.

metrics.name: On-time in-full accepted orders
metrics.numerator: Orders delivered in full, accepted to the agreed criteria, and no later than the promised time.
metrics.denominator: All orders due in the measurement interval.
metrics.boundary: Customer promise and acceptance definition frozen before the period.
cautions: A partial shipment or late order is not OTIF.

calculation_implementation.boundary_note: Calculator does not validate input evidence, measurement method, or physical truth.

metrics.name: Material travel distance per accepted unit
metrics.numerator: Flow-weighted movement distance for identified material classes; report each class separately as well as total.
metrics.denominator: First-pass accepted units.
metrics.boundary: Named surveyed facility layout revision and movement period.
cautions: Synthetic graph distances stay synthetic; do not infer physical travel distance from zone adjacency alone.

metrics.name: Person travel distance per paid labour hour
metrics.numerator: Measured person movement distance within the declared facility boundary.
metrics.denominator: Direct paid labour hours over the same interval.
metrics.boundary: Named facility layout revision; person movement must be measured or explicitly synthetic.
cautions: Do not merge person movement with material handling distance.

metrics.name: Changeover duration
metrics.numerator: Elapsed time from stop for the declared changeover until the cell is ready for the new configuration.
metrics.denominator: One changeover event; publish distribution across repeated events.
metrics.boundary: Named old/new configurations, setup procedure and resource set.
cautions: Readiness is not the same as first conforming output.

metrics.name: Time to first conforming unit
metrics.numerator: Elapsed time until the first independently accepted unit of the new product/configuration.
metrics.denominator: One reconfiguration event.
metrics.boundary: Include setup, ramp loss, required inspection and rework; identify any outsourced queue or transport.
cautions: This is the primary reconfiguration KPI; nominal setup completion is insufficient.

metrics.name: Fabric material yield
metrics.numerator: Measured fabric mass embodied in first-pass accepted units.
metrics.denominator: Gross fabric mass issued to the cutting operation, including measured unusable loss.
metrics.boundary: Same fabric lot, conditioning basis and mass measurement method.
cautions: Report reusable offcuts, scrap, defects and rework separately; do not count unverified recoverability as yield.

calculation_implementation.boundary_note: Calculator does not validate input evidence, measurement method, or physical truth.

metrics.name: Electricity per first-pass accepted unit
metrics.numerator: Metered electricity for the declared production boundary; report idle/base load and rework separately where meters permit.
metrics.denominator: First-pass accepted units.
metrics.boundary: Named facility/cell/process and measurement interval; document shared loads and allocation.
cautions: Do not infer energy from machine nameplate power or simulator defaults.

metrics.name: Disruption recovery time
metrics.numerator: Elapsed time until the qualified route is restored and remains within the predeclared accepted-output and first-pass-quality envelope for the stability window.
metrics.denominator: One named disruption event; aggregate distributions across repeated scenarios.
metrics.boundary: Define detection event, stability window, acceptable rate, quality criteria and any supplier/utility recovery dependency.
cautions: A process restart is not full recovery if quality, skill or material qualification is still missing.

metrics.name: Material lot disposition traceability coverage
metrics.numerator: Critical lots with resolvable links to all relevant descendants and final accepted output, rework, scrap or quarantine disposition.
metrics.denominator: All critical input lots consumed in the period.
metrics.boundary: Frozen lot classification and traceability-query scope.
cautions: A record count or QR-code presence is not proof of complete lineage.

calculation_implementation.boundary_note: Calculator does not validate input evidence, measurement method, or physical truth.

metrics.name: False-eligible assignment rate
metrics.numerator: Assignments initially declared eligible but later rejected by an independent verifier using the same frozen facts and validity time.
metrics.denominator: All assignments declared Eligible in the evaluated corpus.
metrics.boundary: Exact evaluator and verifier versions, source snapshot, evidence validity time and adjudication policy.
cautions: Report the absolute false-eligible count as well. Zero false positives on a small corpus is not proof of universal correctness.

metrics.name: Fully loaded cost per first-pass accepted unit
metrics.numerator: Materials, paid labour, setup, inspection, rework/scrap, utilities, maintenance, depreciation/lease, partner fees, freight, packaging, returns and allocated overhead within the stated accounting policy.
metrics.denominator: First-pass accepted units.
metrics.boundary: Currency, FX date, tax treatment, overhead policy and owned/partner boundary must be explicit.
cautions: Do not compare without identical cost boundary and accounting policy.

metrics.name: Operator workload distribution
metrics.formula: publish per-operator task load, range, median, P95, task repetition and task-specific ergonomic assessment; no single scalar pass score
metrics.numerator: Not a single numerator; use task-specific measured work content and exposure observations.
metrics.denominator: Per-operator scheduled/paid interval and declared task context.
metrics.boundary: Privacy-preserving worker-approved data collection, role-level or pseudonymous aggregation.
cautions: Utilization is not wellbeing; do not infer fatigue, comfort or safety from utilization alone.
